mentions.name: MacroCodex
mentions.description: This app provides sensorless adaptive TDEE (total daily calorie burn) tracking that requires no watch or wearable, aiming for guaranteed weight loss within 2–3 weeks, with results often visible in the first week. It is completely free with no subscription or ads, includes a 2,000+ member community, and works on Android, iOS, and any platform where a PWA can run.
mentions.problem: Wearable-based TDEE tracking requires a device and is less accurate than the sensorless adaptive technique used here.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Guaranteed results are achieved using the state of the art adaptive TDEE (total calorie burn of the day) tracking technique we've developed. It's sensorless, so no watch or other wearable is needed. It's way more accurate than those wearables (data included on the website), and our group has 2,000+ members ( https://macrocodex.app/community/ ). You can also read Play Store reviews.

All this completely free, no subscription or ads: 
https://macrocodex.app/

MacroCodex also works on both Android and iOS and any platform where PWA app can run.

mentions.name: MacroCodex
mentions.description: Free web app (no ads, subscriptions, or payments) that estimates a user's true maintenance calories (adaptive TDEE) over time based on calorie surplus/deficit and weight changes, guiding users to eat above the maintenance line to gain weight or below it to lose weight, with clear gain or loss expected within 2-5 weeks. Has 16k users and includes a knowledge section explaining the method.
mentions.source_excerpt:
MacroCodex uses that relationship to estimate your true maintenance calories over time: https://macrocodex.app/
This can be used to gain or lose weight. You simply need to eat above your maintenance calorie line to gain weight and below it to lose weight. No ads, no subscriptions, no payments, 16k users already.
